description.en: The ID of the physical database. You can obtain this ID by calling [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~).
The number of the page to return.

description.zh:
是否返回表的唯一识别码GUID（Globally Unique Identifier），取值如下：
- **true**：返回表的GUID
- **false**：不返回表的GUID
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the globally unique identifier (GUID) of the table. Valid values:

- **true**: Returns the GUID of the table.

- **false**: Does not return the GUID of the table.

description.zh: 表搜索名，支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on table names.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The tenant ID. You can obtain this ID by calling [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~).

title.zh: 获取数据库的表详情列表

descriptions.zh: 仅管控模式为安全协同的数据库实例可调用此API。
descriptions.en: This API can only be used for database instances where the control mode is set to secure collaboration.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-tables --tid 3000 --database-id 18600000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-name test --return-guid true --real-login-user-uid 1234 --region cn-hangzhou
